stages.name: Rapid Evaluation
stages.notes: No daily loss limit. The limit stops trailing at $25,100, the starting balance plus $100. MFFU's EOD drawdown article (updated 2026-08-24) says "the Max EOD trailing locks in at $100 plus the initial starting balance", and MFFU's plan data on myfundedfutures.com (read 2026-09-29) sets a $25,100 lock on this evaluation. MFFU's evaluation-to-funded article (updated 2026-09-04) says the funded drawdown "will now lock at +$100", which reads as if only funded accounts lock; it never says the evaluation does not, so the plan data wins. MFFU's consistency article (updated 2026-09-25) says no single day's profit should exceed 50% "of your total evaluation profits made", and that going over means you "simply need to trade additional days"; its worked example divides the profit target instead. Modelled against total profit, which matches the rule text.

stages.name: Rapid Sim Funded

payoutPaths.name: Rapid daily payout
payoutPaths.notes: The buffer gates the request and also limits the amount. The Rapid page says "You must first build at least $1,100 in realized profits in the account before requesting any payout." MFFU's Rapid plan page says "Stay above the buffer and you're eligible to request a payout every 24 hours", and the Rapid Reserve Program article (updated 2026-01-16) says "Remaining Sim Funded buffer funds (reference SIM FUNDED ARTICLES) may be withdrawn exclusively following Live account breach". So only money above $26,100 can be withdrawn, and with the $500 minimum the first payout needs $26,600. Payouts every 24 hours; the first is available 24 hours after the first trade.

stages.name: Rapid EOD Sim Funded

payoutPaths.name: Rapid EOD payout
payoutPaths.notes: Each payout after the first needs $250 of net profit since the last payout and a $500 minimum request. The first payout needs a $1,100 buffer, so the balance must reach $26,100: "You must first build at least $1,100 in realized profits in the account before requesting your first payout." The buffer gates the first payout only. MFFU's Rapid Reserve Program article says Rapid sim funded "buffer funds ... may be withdrawn exclusively following Live account breach", which would keep the buffer in the account on every payout. The Rapid EOD page ties the buffer to the first payout only and has its own profit-since-last-payout rule, so it is modelled as the Rapid EOD page says.

stages.name: Pro Sim Funded

payoutPaths.name: Pro payout
payoutPaths.notes: Opens 14 calendar days after the first trade: "Request a payout every 14 calendar days from your first trade" (payout policy overview, updated 2026-08-25). Later payouts also wait 14 days each, which the catalog does not model. Only money above the $2,100 buffer can be taken: the Pro plan page says a payout is "subject to your live equity above the required buffer at the time of request", and the overview says you "Must meet the buffer target before requesting a payout". $100,000 maximum per trader.

payoutPaths.name: Pro one-time withdrawal inside the buffer
payoutPaths.notes: Pro FAQ (updated 2026-06-30): "One-time withdrawal: Allowed before reaching full buffer zone. Up to 60% of profits can be withdrawn, with a minimum of $1,000. Remaining 40% remains for continued trading." The overview says the same: "You can withdraw up to 60% of your profits before fully clearing the buffer." The 60% is taken of profit above the starting balance, once per account, as its first payout. MFFU names no other split, so the plan's 80/20 applies. The 14-day wait applies to every Pro payout. MFFU does not say whether this option stays open once the buffer clears; the catalog cannot close it there, so it can show a bigger first payout than the main path when profit is between the buffer and about 2.5 times the buffer. After any first payout the limit moves to $50,100 and later payouts use the main path.

stages.notes: The limit stops trailing at $50,100 (MFFU's plan data on myfundedfutures.com, read 2026-09-29), and after the first payout it moves there and stays: "After first payout, MLL moves to $50,100 and remains static." No daily loss limit or consistency rule. Pro Live is not modelled: it is funded with a small static balance and a daily loss limit, with no published drawdown. Three payouts in a row trigger a review for live.

stages.name: Builder Sim Funded

payoutPaths.name: Builder payout
payoutPaths.notes: Needs 2 trading days per payout cycle. The buffer (MLL plus $100) must be cleared before any request, and the first payout needs $250 above it ("your account balance must reach at least $2,600" on the 50K), so the buffer is modelled as balance kept back. Later payouts need $250 of net profit since the last one. The consistency rule is measured on the current payout cycle and "resets after each approved payout." Up to 5 sim payouts; the first 48 hours after the first trade.
